text: Own a complete Scala 3 implementation of the constrained neuroarchive-zarr-0.1 profile: rank-four immutable canonical BOLD, exact metadata validation, pure region/gather and sharding plans, start-indexed shards, narrow codec/store capabilities, deterministic publication, and independent Python/zarr-java oracles. General Zarr, mutation, catalogs, caches, and cloud policy stay out of core.
